comments.title: Comment replies
comments.subtitle: When someone comments a keyword on your Instagram or Facebook posts, Whasalia replies to the comment and messages them privately. The conversation continues in the inbox. Each answered comment uses 1 token.
comments.noChannels: Connect your Instagram account or Facebook page in Channels to use comment replies.
comments.reconnectTip: If you connected your account before this feature was turned on, connect it again in Channels to grant the comments permission.
comments.tiktokSoon: TikTok: coming once TikTok approves the app (public replies only; TikTok doesn't allow private messages from a comment).
comments.empty: No rules yet. Create one, for example: when someone comments “price”, reply “We sent you a DM!” and send the price privately.
comments.detachedHint: This rule isn't answering because its account was deleted. Connect that account again in Channels and it resumes on its own, or edit it and pick another account.
comments.deleteBody: It will stop replying to comments. The reply history is kept.

form.name: Name
form.postsError: We couldn't read this account's posts.
form.postsReconnect: Missing permission: connect the account again in Channels.
form.pickAccountFirst: Choose an account to reply on a single post.
form.keywordsHelp: Comma separated. The comment needs just one of them (case and accents don't matter). Empty = reply to every comment.
form.publicHelp: Write several and one is picked at random, so it isn't always the same. Use {name} for the person's name.
form.privateHelp: Sent once per comment, within 7 days (Meta's rule). If the person answers, the conversation continues in the inbox with your AI agent or your team.
form.privatePlaceholder: Hi {name} 👋 It's $15. Can I help you order?
form.onePerPerson: Each person gets a reply once per post.

errors.name: Give the rule a name.
errors.reply: Write a public reply or a private message.
errors.too_long: The private message is too long (max 2,000 characters).
errors.channel: That account is no longer connected.
